hook: Your car switches sides of the road on this bridge.
title: Your Car Switches Road Sides on This Bridge
description:
The Hong Kong-Zhuhai-Macau Bridge links places that drive on opposite sides. Hong Kong and Macau drive on the left, mainland China on the right, so ramps near the ends move your car across.

Series: Places That Shouldn't Exist.

#Shorts #Geography #China
comment_prompt: Left or right side driving? Pick one
